title: The Copper Lantern
author: Elodie Ashgrove
blurb: Beatrix Underhill, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
